title: Orange Olive Spanish Epoisses Tapas Platter
description: A citrusy and crispy Spanish-inspired tapas platter featuring epoisses cheese, perfect for festive gatherings, this dish is vegetarian-friendly and full of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the wok over medium heat and add the olive oil to coat the bottom.
Add the sliced baguette to the wok and toast until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the toasted bread from the wok and set aside.
Add the softened epoisses cheese to the wok and stir until melted and smooth.
Add the orange marmalade, chopped thyme, salt, and pepper to the wok and stir to combine.
Add the pitted green olives and candied orange peel to the wok and stir to combine.
Arrange the toasted bread slices on a platter and top with the epoisses cheese mixture.
Garnish with additional thyme and candied orange peel if desired.
